pkg.invariant: A Training drill counts only when its run is on the record from START to its end with hits, misses, rounds spent and time written and the magazine picture matched the rounds at every shot — a run with no metrics does not count, and Introductory does not open on it.

rows.requirement: A TRAIN UP run on the Range has bounds on the record: one START row (mode:'bounce', lane, targets) and one end row carrying hits, misses, rounds spent and ms, so the ladder's 'all three finished … stored' can be read for TRAIN UP as it already can for TRAIN DOWN. At r.218 TRAIN UP has no START, no clock and no end: every target stands from RESET and a hit target returns after RETURN_S = 3 s; its hits and misses live only in state and on the strip. CL.01's sentence 'light WAIT until START; last target down stops the clock' and its metric 'START and wall time are recorded' describe TRAIN DOWN (r.197), not TRAIN UP. What ENDS a TRAIN UP run is the operator's to give; this row does not define it.
rows.systemMetric: On the Range in bounce today: zero START rows and zero TIME rows after any number of shots (decide('START') at play.html:1032 is mode:'stay' only; the clock at :1103 runs only when mode==='stay'; startLight :1068 has no WAIT state for bounce); hits and misses on the strip :2687 == count(HIT)+count(MISS) rows on this lane since the last RESET row. When built: exactly one START {mode:'bounce'} and one end row with Number.isFinite on each of hits, misses, spent, ms per run, and no RESET row between them.

rows.requirement: The TRAIN DOWN TIME row carries rounds spent — `spent`, the count of magazine decrements between its START row and the last target down, across RELOADs — so all four of his metrics sit in one row and the magazine picture can be checked against the stored run. Record-side, spent equals the count of HIT and MISS rows this lane wrote between START and TIME, a 'MISS DOWN' row included (it spends a round but is neither a hit nor a counted miss). Training is single shot by construction: one FIRE press spends at most one round and a refusal spends none.
rows.systemMetric: TIME.data.spent present and == 30·(state.mag.n−1) + (30 − state.mag.rounds) at the stop (downStart reloads to cap 30, n 1) and == count(rows verb HIT|MISS, this lane, between START and TIME); spent ≥ hits+misses, the difference being MISS DOWN rows. Today TIME.data has {ms,hits,misses} only (:1033) and magSpend (:960) writes no row; hits+misses can undercount spent by MISS DOWN rows (:2696 returns result 'MISS' → :2768 spends; :2704 not reached).

rows.requirement: 'Rounds' on the Qual 40 line is unambiguous: COLD carries misses = rounds − hits; expired = the LAPSE rows (unfired, no round left a magazine); spent = rounds − expired (rounds that left the four magazines) — beside rounds = 40, the programme count by construction. A player who fires nothing ends rounds 40, hits 0, misses 40, expired 40, spent 0.
rows.systemMetric: COLD.data.{misses,expired,spent} present; misses == rounds − hits; expired == state.qualExpired; spent + expired == rounds == 40 on every finished table; spent == 4·10 − (rounds left in the four magazines at COLD) when no MISS DOWN row was written (a MISS DOWN spends a round and is not a qual round, :2696). QUAL_IS_40_ROUNDS reads spent 0 / expired 40.

rows.requirement: 'All three finished' is read from the record, never from a visited screen. Training reads complete for a lane only when, for each of bounce (TRAIN UP), stay (TRAIN DOWN) and qual40 (QUAL 40), at least one run has its START row and its end row (TRAIN UP's end per CL.01.01; TIME per CL.02.01-.02; COLD with no RESET row between its first QUAL row and COLD per CL.03.01-.03) with all four metrics finite, and the magazine truth (CL.15) held on every HIT/MISS row of that run. A run with any metric missing does not count. Fails by name: TRAINUP_UNDEFINED, NO_START, NO_END, RESET_BEFORE_END, METRIC_MISSING, MAG_MISMATCH. The three drills do not reappear as a way around the ladder.
rows.systemMetric: trainingComplete(rows, lane) returns {trainUp, trainDown, qual40} each {finished, hits, misses, spent, ms, fail}; finished == ['hits','misses','spent','ms'].every(k => Number.isFinite(run.end[k])) && !resetBetween && magOk; on an empty record all three read finished:false and Introductory does not open; at r.218 a TRAIN UP run reads TRAINUP_UNDEFINED, a TRAIN DOWN run METRIC_MISSING (spent), a QUAL 40 run METRIC_MISSING (ms).

Reuses DRN-06.01 (the decision record and replay hash, implemented) — no second record. rows.requirement: A finished Training run outlives the tab on the device that ran it: its START row, its end row with the four metrics, who pressed, lane, mode and the replayHash() of its rows are written to a device store the deck already has, and CL.10.02 reads them back after location.reload(). The deck has two stores and forks no third: lib/drone-2525/progression.ts (STAGE_KEY 'drone2525.progression', {reached,firstVisit}, forward-only, try/catch) and IndexedDB 'exel-2525-rec'/'pack'. Today decision records reach 'pack' only as the `extra` of a telemetry sample (decide → sample({ev:'DEC',rec}) → put), keyed by game clock t (a same-t put overwrites), and only when a Worker exists; ev() rows (HIT, MISS, LAPSE, QUAL) are not written; nothing reads 'pack' back. state.events and state.decisions are memory.
rows.systemMetric: After a finished TRAIN DOWN run and location.reload(), CL.10.02 returns the same {finished:true, hits, misses, spent, ms} as before; with the store cleared it returns finished:false and Introductory stays shut. rows.requirement: The magazine picture matches the rounds, on the glass and on the record. Glass: the number reads state.mag.rounds; the fill is clipped one bar per round at any cap (--cut = MAG_BAR_TOPS[30 − rounds]); his colour rule (green ≥ 20 · amber 6–19 · red ≤ 5); the frame raster never changes; RELOAD is one row and refuses when full; QUAL issues four 10-round magazines; an empty magazine refuses the shot and spends nothing. Record: rounds remaining == cap − count(HIT|MISS rows this lane) since the last RELOAD, START or RESET row (START and RESET refill silently); one FIRE press moves the picture at most one step. A Training run whose picture and rows disagree at any HIT/MISS row does not count (CL.10.02 MAG_MISMATCH).

Gated green at r.218: MAGAZINE_IS_HIS_DRAWING (:4950), MAGAZINE_KEEPS_ITS_FRAME (:4955), BARS_OVER_THE_GRID (:4956), TRAINING_MAG_30 (:4585), EMPTY_MAG_REFUSES (:4632), RELOAD_ON_RECORD (:4634), QUAL_FOUR_MAGS (:4636), MAG_ROW_ONE_LINE (:4877). pkg.invariant: A run with no metrics does not count: every press and every round that leaves is a row naming who pressed, every run closes with hits, misses, rounds spent and time, the magazine picture matches the rounds, and a step whose line above is empty does not open.

rows.requirement: The lawn record is the deck's one canonical record. Every press, refusal, shot, run-open and run-close is a row written through ev()/decide(), stamped eventId, peerId, role (HI|AI), verb, id, t, result, data, folded into replayHash() and carried to every seat by the same door as HOLD/REJECT/START/TIME/COLD. A drill counts toward a step only when its rows exist and its closing row carries the four metrics: hits, misses, rounds spent, time. A run with no metrics does not count; a press with no row did not happen.
rows.systemMetric: For every drill a ladder line marks complete, the record holds exactly one START and one TIME|COLD closer with hits, misses, rounds and ms all non-null; replayHash() over that run's rows is stored on the line and equals a recomputation on replay; a line without those rows reads empty.

Every closer carries all four. rows.requirement: The cue row. A sensor seat (S1, S2 - Cue only, the whole circle - or a SIL feed under CRS-CL.M02) naming a track is a CUE row: id (the track), data.seat, data.class (AIR|GROUND|RAM|HIGH), data.bearing (UCRS AAAA), written through decide() so it hashes and travels to every seat. On the lawn Fire counts on a track only after its CUE row; a shot with no prior CUE is FAIL SHOT_BEFORE_CUE. The Cue mode's refusal 'No sensor has named it' is HOLD NO_CUE and spends nothing. rows.requirement: Refusal is not fail. HOLD and REJECT rows are refusals: no round leaves, nothing is scored, a refusal never costs a round; the existing reasons stand (ROUND_NOT_OPEN, CLOCK_RUNNING, EMPTY_MAGAZINE, NO_RED_BOX, AMBER_NO_APPROVE, TARGET_DOWN, TARGET_GONE, TWO_HUMANS, NOT_THE_MARKERS_SEAT, WRONG_LANE, ROW_AUTHOR_MISMATCH and the rest). Lawn reasons are NEW and map one-to-one to the CL.13 strip line: NOT_IN_ARC <-> 'HOLD · NOT IN ARC', OTHER_SEAT <-> 'HOLD · OTHER SEAT', NO_CUE, TRACK_DOWN (shoot-look-shoot), NEED_2 <-> 'RIPPLE · NEED 2', NOT_SALVO_SEAT, EMPTY. A FAIL (CL.15.07) is the other kind: the round left or the line broke, and the run fails. The closer carries pass:true|false.

The closer's result reads 'FAIL <reason>' and pass:false. FAIL is not HOLD/REJECT: a refusal spends nothing; a FAIL is a round that left or a line that broke.

rows.requirement: Each reason is a pure function of (rows, beat data, the CL.12 table) and gives the same answer on replay. SHOT_BEFORE_CUE = HIT|MISS X with no prior CUE X. WRONG_CLASS = HIT|MISS where track.class is not in seat.classes. HELD_TRACK_FIRED = HIT|MISS where track.protected in {HUMAN, NAS}. FRIENDLY_HIT = HIT whose id is a seat or friendly icon. NO_GUN_CAN_LOCK = a live hostile track whose class and bearing lie in no un-LOST seat's arc. RIPPLE_MOVED_ONCE = APPROVE {mode RIPPLE} followed by one shot row. MISSILE_SEAT_ON_BAIT = HIT|MISS by T1|Patriot on track.bait. LAWN_GUN_HIGH_TRACK = DESIGNATED|HIT|MISS on class HIGH by A1-A4|G1|C1|C2. DEFENDED_POINT_HIT = a hostile track reaches DA-CP|FF|ATP|MC un-HIT. DECOY_CHASED and FORMATION_BROKEN have no row test until 'chased', 'formation' and 'restore' are defined. A gun going down is a NEW LOST row {seat} written by the drill or beat (Advance LOSS, beat 6): the input to NO_GUN_CAN_LOCK and to CL.08.
rows.systemMetric: Equal replayHash implies an identical FAIL set; each predicate re-evaluated on the stored rows returns the stored FAIL rows and no others.

rows.requirement: CL.10 made a row test. A ladder line reads complete only when, for each drill the step requires, the record holds one START and one TIME|COLD with the four metrics, the magazine match at close, zero FAIL rows from that step's list, and the run's replayHash stored on the line. TRAINING = TIME(bounce) + TIME(stay) + COLD(qual40), scene range. INTRODUCTORY = the same three with scene capital plus closers for path 1, 2-on-1, 1v1, 3v3 (data.path; the Key Deliverable's INTRO.01-.04). INTERMEDIATE = PAIR-AIR + PAIR-GROUND. ADVANCE = MIX + LEAK + LOSS and a LINES row {missile, low, swarm:'not up', network, assets} - five fields, no more (CL.04.10). REAL-WORLD = nine BEAT-n closers and a LINES row with all five complete. Opening a step whose line above is empty - by the SCEN select, the data-mode button or the query string - writes REJECT LADDER_EMPTY (NEW reason, existing verb) and does not open; loading the X-BAT package on a partial LINES row does the same.
rows.systemMetric: With an empty record: open Real-World -> REJECT LADDER_EMPTY and the scene unchanged; load X-BAT -> REJECT LADDER_EMPTY. With Training's three closers and Introductory's none: Intermediate -> REJECT LADDER_EMPTY. predicate(replay) == predicate(live); each line's stored hash equals replayHash() over its rows (the r.197 pattern: replayHash() !== h0).
rows.delta: New. CL.10 :31/:53 and DD-122 'the lock is tested by trying to open Real-World with an empty record. It must not open'; DD-124 adds the X-BAT door, 'Neither may open.' The three doors measured: SCEN select :444-451 (9v9 reads LOCKED as a label only), data-mode :455 -> applyMode :3957, URLSearchParams :5995-5996 (opens a lane and a mode with no record check). rows.requirement: Advance is the fourth rung: Mix, Leak and Loss, three drills on the lawn, each its own run, in that order. Up at once in each: one air track (an Avenger seat's), one ground threat (G1's), one incoming round (C1's or C2's) — not a swarm. The lawn modes first required here are Shoot-look-shoot, Ripple, Sector and Layer (Hold, Cue, Single carried from Introductory; Burst 3 is the Range's). Opens only when Intermediate's two runs (air, then ground) carry TIME rows with no wrong-class shot and no held track fired on (CL.10). Opens Real-World only when all three Advance drills carry a TIME row with no FRIENDLY_HIT and no NO_GUN_CAN_LOCK, and the five lines are stored with the swarm line reading 'not up'. A link, a menu or a query string cannot open it over an empty Intermediate line.
rows.systemMetric: Exactly three Advance TIME rows (MIX, LEAK, LOSS), each with ms, hits, misses, rounds, seat. Opening Advance with Intermediate's ground TIME row absent writes a REJECT of the ROUND_NOT_OPEN shape (play.html:1030) and no scene change. Opening Real-World, or loading the X-BAT package, with fewer than three Advance TIME rows, any named fail on them, or any of the five fields unset, is refused. 'Advance' never appears among #rngMode's options (:494).

I did not stop, because the gate's stated purpose is 'do not measure a stale tree' and this tree is the opposite of stale: f8f7a8a51 is its ancestor, the four commits after it are record-only (DD-130 brief, DD-131 session decisions, lawnSeats record + gate, tree-check script, asks-persist fix), and the pinned inputs are byte-identical by blob (delta 4a0417de = ad4dcb62's; format f225af4e). Every citation was read from f8f7a8a51's objects via git show. If the orchestrator treats any HEAD but f8f7a8a51 as disqualifying, discard this package on that ground alone - it is a true report, not a claim. (2) Two facts are HEAD-only and labelled wherever used: DD-131 (the session's own decisions under his sign-off: r.219 two drills, r.220 HOLD/BEFORE_CUE at 2 s, 'two on one system' = the LIVE room, QUALIFIED_MATCH 1->2->6, the run-keyed store) and tests/lawn-record.test.mjs. They are reversible decisions, not his words; rows name them as such. (3) Overridden: C2's R02 'Decided' (spec :116); C1's two-family M for R03 (spec :102) and C2's zero-headroom M (spec :88); C1's two-drill INTRO.01 (delta :26). (4) Both colleague texts were truncated by the harness; C1 lost INTRO.03 onward, C2 lost INTRO.04 onward, so neither's fills could be compared row by row - the 12 fills here are the voter's, scoped to this triad's question (Training, the eleven Introductory rows, ADV.01 with the Qual 40 level correction). PLAN-D2525-INT.01, ADV.02 and RW.01-.04 are left to the Intermediate/Advance/Real-World triads. (5) Status changes proposed on delta rows (R01 Planned->Live) are the human's to accept; nothing here edits the delta. pkg.invariant: A run with no metrics does not count: no step opens, and the X-BAT package does not load, until the line above it is on the record — hits, misses, rounds spent, time, and who pressed — and on the lawn no shot was taken before the cue.

rows.requirement: A drill counts toward the ladder only when its run ends with one completion row carrying his four metrics — hits, misses, rounds spent, time (ms) — and who pressed (seat / HI id). The magazine picture matches the rounds at every count. A run with no completion row does not count, on the Range or on the lawn; CRS-CL.10's lock reads these rows, not a visited screen.
rows.systemMetric: Per finished run exactly one closing row: decide('TIME','RANGE',{mode,lane,ms,hits,misses}) (play.html:1033) for TRAIN DOWN, decide('COLD','RANGE',{mode:'qual40',lane,hits,rounds,score}) (:1040) for QUAL 40, and one for TRAIN UP (owed); each with hits, misses, rounds, ms and rec.actor (:2590); rounds = HIT+MISS rows of the run (:2704-2707) = cap×n − rounds left (magSpend :960; RELOAD rows :961-964); hudMag count === state.mag.rounds at every shot (DD-114's 31 distinct clips). Measured at r.218: TRAIN DOWN 3/4 fields (no rounds); QUAL 40 2/4 (no misses, no ms); TRAIN UP 0/4 — decide('START'/'TIME') exist only with mode:'stay' (:1032-1033).

The Range has no cue gate. CRS-CL.04.01 is the same rule inside Real-World's beat 1.
